headline: DeepSeek hits 11.7% — Google's Gemini 3.6 flash breaks records
summary: DeepSeek's newest flash model just claimed an all-time token-share record at 11.7%, while Google's Gemini 3.6 flash vaulted 26 spots in a single day to rank 5th and set its own record at 6.9%. The reshuffling is real: Google provider-wide jumped 6.2 points overnight, and the top three are now DeepSeek, Tencent, and DeepSeek again.
highlights: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-20260731 hits 11.7% token share — an all-time high
google/gemini-3.6-flash-20260721 surges 26 ranks to #5, also sets a record at 6.9%
Google provider share jumps 6.2 points in one day; up 4.1 points over the week
Three new entrants: Moonshot AI's kimi-k2.5-0127, Google's gemini-3.1-pro-preview, and Anthropic's claude-4.6-opus-20260205
Three dropouts: OpenAI's gpt-5-mini, Qwen's qwen3.7-flash, and Poolside's laguna-xs
DeepSeek provider share dips 1.7 points today but remains dominant at 24.0%
